paite: Huai nite in, mipi tampitak ahong om nawn ua, nek ding bangmah anei kei ua, ama'n anungzuite asam a, akiang uah,
heading: Mipi Sangli Vakna / (Mat 15.32-39)
english: In those days, when there was a very great multitude, and they had nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples to himself and said to them,

paite: "Mipite tu in ka kiang ah ni thum a-omta ua, nek ding bangmah aneih louh ziak un ka lainat mahmah hi.
english: “I have compassion on the multitude, because they have stayed with me now three days and have nothing to eat.

paite: An ngawl in a-inn uah paisak leng lamkal ah abah kha ding uh; khenkhatte houh ahong paina uh agamla mahmah ngal a," achi hi.
english: If I send them away fasting to their home, they will faint on the way, for some of them have come a long way.”

paite: Anungzuite'n, "Mi'n hiai gamdai ah koi a tanghou in ahia hiai mite ahihvah theih ding uh?" chi in amah adawng uhi.
english: His disciples answered him, “From where could one satisfy these people with bread here in a deserted place?”

paite: Huan ama'n, "Tanghou phel bangzah na nei ua?" chi in amau adong a. Amau, "Phel sagih," achi uhi.
english: He asked them, “How many loaves do you have?” They said, “Seven.”

paite: Huan mipite lei a tu ding in thu apia a; tanghou phel sagih ala a, kipahthu agen khit in abalkham a, ama ua lui ding in anungzuite kiang ah apia a; huchi in mipite ma ah aluita uhi.
english: He commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground, and he took the seven loaves. Having given thanks, he broke them and gave them to his disciples to serve, and they served the multitude.

paite: Ngasa tawmchik leng anei ua; ama'n avualzawl a, huaite leng ama ua lui ding in thu apia hi.
english: They also had a few small fish. Having blessed them, he said to serve these also.

paite: Huchi in ane ua, akham chiat ua; bawm sagih dim in akhamval nen uh aluak uhi.
english: They ate and were filled. They took up seven baskets of broken pieces that were left over.

paite: Amau sangli vel ahi ua; ama'n amaute apaisakta hi.
english: Those who had eaten were about four thousand. Then he sent them away.

paite: Amah bel anungzuite kiang ah long ah atuang pah a, huchi in Dalmanutha gam atung uhi.
english: Immediately he entered into the boat with his disciples and came into the region of Dalmanutha.

paite: Pharisaite ahong pai ua, amah ze-etna ding in, amah a pan van a kipan a chiamtehna zong in amah ahong sel uhi.
heading: Chiamtehna Ngetna / (Mat 12.38-42; 16.1-4)
english: The Pharisees came out and began to question him, seeking from him a sign from heaven and testing him.

paite: Huan amah alungsim in nakpi in anak kuaikuai a, "Bang achia hiai khangte'n chiamtehna zong uh ahia? Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, hiai khangte kiang ah chiamtehna himhim piak ahi kei ding," achi hi.
english: He sighed deeply in his spirit and said, “Why does this generation seek a sign? Most certainly I tell you, no sign will be given to this generation.”

paite: Huchi in amaute paisan in long ah atuang nawn a, gal khat lam ah apaisanta hi.
english: He left them, and again entering into the boat, departed to the other side.

paite: Huan anungzuite'n tanghou atawi mangngilh ua, tanghou phel khat kia lou ngal long ah tanghou dang himhim lah anei kei uhi.
heading: Pharisaite Leh Herod Silngou / (Mat 16.5-12)
english: They forgot to take bread; and they didn’t have more than one loaf in the boat with them.

paite: Huan ama'n akiang uah, "Pharisaite silngou leh Herod silngou lak ah kiveng unla, pilvang un," achi hi.
english: He warned them, saying, “Take heed: beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and the yeast of Herod.”

paite: Amau, "Tanghou i neih louh ziak ei ve," chi in akingaihtuah uhi.
english: They reasoned with one another, saying, “It’s because we have no bread.”

paite: Jesu'n huai atheih in, akiang uah, "Bangziak a tanghou na neih louh ziak ua kingaihtuah na hi ua? Tu nangawn in na theisiam kei lai uh maw? Theisiam lou lai maw? Na lungtang uh na khauhsak ua hia?
english: Jesus, perceiving it, said to them, “Why do you reason that it’s because you have no bread? Don’t you perceive yet or understand? Is your heart still hardened?

paite: Mit nei napi in na mu kei ua hia? Bil nei napi in na za kei ua hia? Theigige lou uh maw?
english: Having eyes, don’t you see? Having ears, don’t you hear? Don’t you remember?

paite: Sangnga lak a tanghou phel nga ka balkhap lai in anen bawm bangzah ahia na luahdim uh?" achi hi. Amau, "Sawm-le-nih,” achi uhi.
english: When I broke the five loaves among the five thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up?” They told him, “Twelve.”

paite: Huan sangli a dia sagih ka balkhap lai in, anen bawm bangzah ahia na luahdim uh? achi a. Amau akiang ah, "Sagih," achi uhi.
english: “When the seven loaves fed the four thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up?” They told him, “Seven.”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Bangchidan a tu nangawn a theisiam lou lailai na hi ua?" achi hi.
english: He asked them, “Don’t you understand yet?”

paite: Huai nung in Bethsaida ahong tung uhi. Huan akiang ah mittaw ahon pi ua, amah khoih ding in angen uhi.
heading: Bethsaida A Mittaw Hihdamna
english: He came to Bethsaida. They brought a blind man to him and begged him to touch him.

paite: Ama'n mittaw khut alen a, khua a kipan apikhia hi; amit ah chil sia in atung a akhut akoih khit in, "Khua na mu thei hia?" chi in adong hi.
english: He took hold of the blind man by the hand, and brought him out of the village. When he had spat on his eyes, and laid his hands on him, he asked him if he saw anything.

paite: Amah hong dakkhia a, "Mite ka mu; singkung pai bang in ka mu,” achi hi.
english: He looked up, and said, “I see men, but I see them like walking trees.”

paite: Amit ah akhut akoih nawn a, ahong hakkhia a, ahong dam maimah a, bangkim chiantak in amutheita hi.
english: Then again he laid his hands on his eyes. He looked intently, and was restored, and saw everyone clearly.

paite: Huan Jesu'n, khua ah leng lut ke'n chi in a-inn ah apaisakta hi.
english: He sent him away to his house, saying, “Don’t enter into the village, nor tell anyone in the village.”

paite: Huan Jesu leh anungzuite ahong pai zel ua, Kaisaria Philippi khuate ahong tung ua; huan pai kawm in anungzuite kiang ah, "Mite'n kei kua ka hi ahon chi ua?" chi in adong hi.
heading: Peter In Jesu Khrist Hihna Apuangkhia / (Mat 16.13-20; Luk 9.18-21)
english: Jesus went out, with his disciples, into the villages of Caesarea Philippi. On the way he asked his disciples, “Who do men say that I am?”

paite: Amau, "Baptispa Johan ahi, ahon chi ua; midang in Elijah ahi, ahon chi ua; khenkhat in bel, zawlnei kuahiam ahi, ahon chi uh," achi uhi.
english: They told him, “John the Baptizer, and others say Elijah, but others, one of the prophets.”

paite: Huan ama'n akiang uah, "Ahihleh nou kei kua ka hi na hon chi ua?" chi in adong hi. Peter in akiang ah, "Khrist na hi," chi in adawng hi.
english: He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?” Peter answered, “You are the Christ.”

paite: Huan ama'n atanchin kuamah hilh louh ding in achi bikbek hi.
english: He commanded them that they should tell no one about him.

paite: Huan Mihing Tapa in thil tampi athuak dingte, upate, siampu liante, laigelhmite deih louh a a-om ding, hihlup a a-om ding leh ni thum nung a athohnawn ding thute amau ahilh hi.
heading: Jesu'n Asihna leh Athohnawnna Ding Agenkhol / (Mat 16.21-28; Luk 9.22-27)
english: He began to teach them that the Son of Man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders, the chief priests, and the scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.

paite: Huai thute chiantak in agen hi. Huan Peter in amah apituam a, atai hi.
english: He spoke to them openly. Peter took him and began to rebuke him.

paite: Himahleh amah ahong kihei a, anungzuite muh in, Peter atai a, "Setan, ka nung ah pai in, Pathian thilte ngaihtuah lou in, mihing thilte na ngaihtuah zaw,” achi hi.
english: But he, turning around and seeing his disciples, rebuked Peter, and said, “Get behind me, Satan! For you have in mind not the things of God, but the things of men.”

paite: Huan mipite, anungzuite toh asam a, akiang uah, "Kuapeuh in hon zuih a-utleh amah kingaihsak lou in, ama kros pua in hon zui hen.
english: He called the multitude to himself with his disciples and said to them, “Whoever wants to come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.

paite: Kuapeuh ahinna humbit ut in atan ding a; kuapeuh keimah ziak leh tanchinhoih ziak a ahinna tan in ahumbit ding hi.
english: For whoever wants to save his life will lose it; and whoever will lose his life for my sake and the sake of the Good News will save it.

paite: Mi'n khovel apum in nei henla, ahinna tan taleh amah a ding in bang aphatuam dia?
english: For what does it profit a man to gain the whole world and forfeit his life?

paite: Mi'n ahinna tang in bang ape thei dia?
english: For what will a man give in exchange for his life?

paite: Kuapeuh hiai khang a angkawm leh gilou chingte lak ah keimah leh ka thu zumpih, Mihing Tapa in, angel siangthoute toh a Pa thupina a kivan a ahong hun chiang in, huai mi ahon zumpih thuk sam ding," achi hi.
english: For whoever will be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation, the Son of Man also will be ashamed of him when he comes in his Father’s glory with the holy angels.”
